sourceItems.title: 多地出台楼市调控措施：分城施策 考验调控智慧
normalizedClaims: Around the National Day holiday, many hot cities including Beijing, Tianjin, Hefei and Zhengzhou tightened property policy with purchase restrictions, higher down-payment ratios and differentiated mortgage rules.
The stated objective was to suppress investment/speculative demand and cool overheated housing markets.
This marked a policy turn away from the prior broad easing/rapid-price-rise phase in hot cities.
observedChanges: a new multi-city demand/credit tightening regime begins in hot housing markets

sourceItems.title: 关于减征1.6升及以下排量乘用车车辆购置税的通知
normalizedClaims: From 2017-01-01 through 2017-12-31, purchase tax on passenger vehicles with engine displacement at or below 1.6L would be levied at 7.5%.
The prior 5% temporary incentive therefore partially rolled back rather than ending completely; the legal rate would return to 10% from 2018.
The policy creates a measurable demand-baseline reset for OEMs exposed to small-displacement passenger vehicles.
observedChanges: a new partial rollback of the small-engine auto demand subsidy is fixed for 2017

sourceItems.title: 欧佩克8年来首次决定减产
normalizedClaims: OPEC agreed on Nov-30 to cut crude production by about 1.2m barrels per day and cap output near 32.5m bpd beginning 2017-01-01.
It was OPEC's first formal production-cut decision since 2008 and explicitly targeted a more balanced oil market.
observedChanges: a new global crude-supply state begins with a formal coordinated cut

sourceItems.title: 欧佩克8年来首达减产协议 国际油价大涨
normalizedClaims: The OPEC agreement was accompanied by an understanding that non-OPEC producers would also cut, including a Russian commitment of roughly 300kbpd.
WTI rose about 9.31% and Brent about 8.82% on Nov-30, showing immediate market absorption of the new supply agreement.
observedChanges: the fresh supply agreement is immediately reflected in crude prices, creating a clear expectation-absorption test

sourceItems.title: 发改委再次强调：基本面不支持钢铁煤炭价格大幅上涨
normalizedClaims: After an 18-week coal-price rise of more than 60% from the start of the year, policy measures had begun to reverse the shortage.
A new policy allowed all legal and compliant coal mines meeting safety conditions to organize production on a 330-working-day basis through the heating season.
The Bohai-Rim 5500kcal coal index had already fallen for three consecutive weeks by late November, indicating that supply normalization was beginning to affect the downstream price flow.
observedChanges: a new supply-release regime begins to counter the earlier policy-induced coal shortage

sourceItems.title: 汾渭能源常毅军：明年动力煤、炼焦煤供需如何演变？
normalizedClaims: The report described a progression from partial capacity releases in September/October to Nov-16 coverage allowing all safe, compliant operating mines to use a 330-day production schedule.
It estimated the 276-versus-330-day difference represented several hundred million tonnes of effective annualized supply, explaining why the policy change was economically material.
observedChanges: the policy reversal materially increases available legal production capacity

sourceItems.title: 中国证监会 香港证监会联合公告：正式启动深港通
normalizedClaims: The CSRC and Hong Kong SFC approved formal launch of the Shenzhen-Hong Kong Stock Connect.
Trading was scheduled to begin on 2016-12-05 after rules, technology and supervisory arrangements were completed.
observedChanges: an already-announced market-opening mechanism moves from preparation to live implementation

sourceItems.title: 深港通首日运行顺畅 北上资金活跃度高于南下资金
normalizedClaims: Shenzhen-Hong Kong Stock Connect began trading on Dec-5 and operated smoothly on the first day.
Northbound activity was more active than southbound activity, indicating real but still early cross-border participation.
observedChanges: implementation confirms an earlier-announced structural opening but does not create a wholly new thesis

sourceItems.title: 化工：甲醇和纯苯等价格大涨；钛白粉环保影响产能
normalizedClaims: Domestic titanium-dioxide producers raised prices again by roughly RMB800-1,000/t in December.
An environmental incident/inspection in the Panzhihua-Xichang region was reported to affect about 360kt of capacity, around 11%, worsening already-tight inventories.
The report also noted weak seasonal downstream acceptance, creating an explicit demand-side counterpoint to the fresh supply shock.
observedChanges: a fresh environmental capacity shock arrives on top of an already-rising TiO2 cycle

eventClusters.statement: Hot-city housing policy abruptly tightened around the National Day holiday through purchase restrictions, higher down-payments and stricter mortgage policy, marking a turn away from the prior demand-supportive regime.
eventClusters.contradictionSearchNotes: A major negative policy state does not automatically imply every property-linked company is uninvestable; exposure differs by geography, inventory, balance sheet and non-property end markets.
eventClusters.researchQuestion: Does any listed company have a company-specific path that is resilient to hot-city demand tightening, or should the aggregate policy shift remain No selection?

eventClusters.statement: The 2017 purchase tax on <=1.6L passenger vehicles was fixed at 7.5%, partially reversing the 5% incentive while avoiding an immediate return to the full 10% rate.
eventClusters.contradictionSearchNotes: The policy is simultaneously a demand headwind versus 2016 and a softer landing versus full subsidy expiry. Company product mix and expectation baseline matter.
eventClusters.researchQuestion: Which OEMs or suppliers have a cutoff-valid earnings path that can outperform the reset baseline rather than simply relying on 2016 stimulus demand?

eventClusters.statement: OPEC reached its first formal production-cut agreement since 2008, with additional non-OPEC participation, creating a new coordinated crude-supply state effective from 2017.
eventClusters.contradictionSearchNotes: Oil futures immediately jumped about 9%, so the agreement is fresh but already partially absorbed. Integrated Chinese oil companies may have upstream benefits offset by refining/downstream economics.
eventClusters.researchQuestion: Is there a direct A-share oil expression with incremental earnings leverage and residual expectation room after the immediate crude-price jump?

eventClusters.statement: China broadened the shift from the 276-day coal-production regime to 330-day production for safe compliant mines, materially increasing effective supply and beginning to reverse the earlier shortage-driven price spike.
eventClusters.contradictionSearchNotes: The state change is negative for pure coal-price continuation but may improve downstream power/industrial margins with a lag. Search both upstream losers and downstream company exceptions rather than stopping at the aggregate.
eventClusters.researchQuestion: Can lower coal-cost exposure create a cutoff-valid downstream company opportunity before the coal-price normalization is fully reflected?

eventClusters.statement: Shenzhen-Hong Kong Stock Connect moved from the already-announced August framework into live trading in December, confirming market opening but largely implementing a known structural thesis.
eventClusters.contradictionSearchNotes: Principle approval occurred in August, so December launch must not be relabeled as a fresh event merely because implementation began.
eventClusters.researchQuestion: Does implementation create any base-horizon company edge beyond an already-known market-opening narrative?

eventClusters.statement: A fresh environmental capacity disruption in the Panzhihua-Xichang TiO2 chain tightened an already-rising market and triggered another large price increase in December.
eventClusters.contradictionSearchNotes: The TiO2 upcycle already existed before Q4, so V1.9 may only use the incremental environmental capacity hit if a pre-event baseline and direct company earnings bridge are frozen; repeated price hikes alone are continuation.
eventClusters.researchQuestion: Does the new capacity hit create an incremental earnings reset for an integrated/direct producer beyond the already-known 2016 TiO2 upcycle?

evidenceDocuments.title: 万科A 2016年第三季度报告
evidenceDocuments.publisher: 万科企业股份有限公司
normalizedClaims: 1-9M revenue was about RMB117.055bn, +47.06% YoY; attributable profit about RMB8.262bn, +20.54%.
Operating cash flow was about RMB42.986bn, a very large improvement from the prior-year negative base.
The company still faced material governance/transaction uncertainty around the Shenzhen Metro proposal while the new multi-city property tightening directly weakened the aggregate demand backdrop.

evidenceDocuments.title: 上汽集团2016年第三季度报告
evidenceDocuments.publisher: 上海汽车集团股份有限公司
normalizedClaims: 1-9M revenue was about RMB523.855bn, +11.50% YoY; attributable profit about RMB23.092bn, +8.60%; ex-item profit +7.22%.
Operating cash flow was about RMB15.826bn, down 19.85% YoY.
The company therefore entered the tax-reset event with profitable scale and positive cash generation, but without a fresh company-specific earnings reset.

evidenceDocuments.title: 长安汽车2016年第三季度报告
evidenceDocuments.publisher: 重庆长安汽车股份有限公司
normalizedClaims: 1-9M revenue was about RMB53.607bn, +11.43% YoY; attributable profit about RMB7.739bn, +14.81%; ex-item profit +13.04%.
Operating cash flow was about RMB6.493bn, down 19.28% YoY.
The company was benefiting from the 2016 auto-demand boom, so the 2017 tax increase represents a baseline headwind rather than a new positive company driver.

evidenceDocuments.title: 长城汽车2016年第三季度报告
evidenceDocuments.publisher: 长城汽车股份有限公司
normalizedClaims: 1-9M revenue was about RMB63.345bn, +20.42% YoY; attributable profit about RMB7.209bn, +16.11%; ex-item profit +18.60%.
Contemporaneous coverage repeatedly described purchase-tax support as helping Q3 sales, making the 2017 partial rollback a real demand-comparison risk rather than a company-specific fresh positive.

evidenceDocuments.title: 中国石油2016年度业绩预告
evidenceDocuments.publisher: 中国石油天然气股份有限公司
normalizedClaims: The company warned that 2016 attributable profit would decline sharply year on year because crude and natural-gas realization prices remained low.
The warning was issued before the Nov-30 OPEC cut, providing a clean weak pre-event earnings baseline for an upstream oil expression.
A new oil-price recovery could improve the path, but the cutoff evidence did not yet show realized post-cut earnings conversion.

evidenceDocuments.title: 中国石化2016年第三季度报告
evidenceDocuments.publisher: 中国石油化工股份有限公司
normalizedClaims: 1-9M revenue was about RMB1.364tn, -11.3% YoY; attributable profit about RMB29.166bn, +12.6%; operating cash flow about RMB131.7bn, +13.3%.
The upstream exploration/production segment remained loss-making at roughly RMB-30.865bn EBIT, while refining EBIT was about RMB43.504bn and had risen sharply.
This is a diversified integrated exposure: higher crude can repair upstream economics while partially compressing refining margins, so OPEC is not a simple one-factor earnings bridge.

evidenceDocuments.title: 中国石化公司深度：油价进入震荡向上通道
normalizedClaims: The report cited China Petroleum & Chemical at about RMB5.30, around 17x 2016E PE and roughly 0.93x PB.
It modeled 2017E EPS around RMB0.48 versus 2016E around RMB0.32 and estimated that a US$5/10 oil-price increase from a US$50 baseline could add about RMB0.12/RMB0.18 EPS.
The same sensitivity explicitly included both positive upstream/inventory effects and negative refining-spread effects, supporting a measurable but mixed integrated-company bridge.

evidenceDocuments.title: 中海油服2016年第三季度报告
evidenceDocuments.publisher: 中海油田服务股份有限公司
normalizedClaims: The company stated that 1-9M profit after impairment was about RMB-1.8bn.
Despite some oil-price recovery, the global oilfield-services market was expected to remain weak and the company expected a large full-year loss.
A fresh OPEC cut therefore did not yet provide a cutoff-valid near/base-horizon realized oil-service earnings bridge.

evidenceDocuments.title: 华能国际2016年第三季度报告
evidenceDocuments.publisher: 华能国际电力股份有限公司
normalizedClaims: 1-9M revenue was about RMB83.221bn, -14.43% YoY; attributable profit about RMB9.389bn, -29.06%; ex-item profit -27.55%.
Operating cash flow was about RMB27.399bn, down 22.93%.

The company attributed profit decline to lower coal-fired tariffs, lower power volume and more market-priced power, meaning lower coal prices could help but would enter a business with multiple independent earnings headwinds.

evidenceDocuments.title: 美的集团2016年第三季度报告
evidenceDocuments.publisher: 美的集团股份有限公司
normalizedClaims: 1-9M revenue was about RMB116.378bn, +4.49% YoY; attributable profit about RMB12.808bn, +16.31%; ex-item profit +30.47%.
Operating cash flow was about RMB19.037bn, +5.94%.
Toshiba Home Appliances consolidation and KUKA-related investment activity were already company-specific drivers independent of the December Shenzhen-Connect implementation.

evidenceDocuments.title: 佰利联2016年第三季度报告
evidenceDocuments.publisher: 河南佰利联化学股份有限公司
normalizedClaims: 1-9M revenue was about RMB2.032bn, +6.96% YoY; attributable profit about RMB119.5m, +103.65%; ex-item profit +106.82%.
Operating cash flow was about RMB-417.3m despite the profit recovery.

After the Longmang acquisition, goodwill was about RMB4.621bn and short-term borrowings about RMB2.484bn, while the acquisition/private-placement structure materially increased balance-sheet and capital-allocation complexity.

evidenceDocuments.title: 佰利联：钛精矿涨价及环保停产影响，有望继续助推钛白粉价格上涨
normalizedClaims: The report cited a price around RMB14.13 and a target around RMB16.00 before the Dec-14 environmental-capacity event.
It already highlighted more than ten TiO2 price increases during 2016 and roughly 40%+ product-price appreciation, making the old upcycle part of the frozen baseline rather than fresh evidence.
The company had just raised TiO2 prices by RMB1,000/t on Dec-6, so any V1.9 escalation must isolate the later environmental capacity hit rather than relabel the whole 2016 price cycle as new.

evidenceDocuments.title: 安纳达2016年度业绩预告（随三季报）
evidenceDocuments.publisher: 安徽安纳达钛业股份有限公司
normalizedClaims: The company forecast 2016 attributable profit of roughly RMB35m-40m after the prior-year loss.
The stated driver was higher TiO2 selling prices and recovering gross margin, confirming that the industry rebound was already well known before the Dec-14 environmental shock.
The frozen price regime also showed much stronger 20d and 60d absorption for Annada than for Baililian, making it a cleaner-balance-sheet but more crowded expression candidate.
